title: Liver disease: cirrhosis, hepatitis C, fatty liver
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's liver disease.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for history of hepatitis C.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old female presenting today for a routine follow-up regarding her history of hepatitis C. She reports feeling well and has no new concerns or symptoms. She successfully completed a course of antiviral treatment several years ago. She achieved a sustained virologic response and has remained stable since that time. She reports no signs of liver damage or discomfort.

Medication List
Multivitamin daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. She appears healthy and in no acute distress. Skin is warm and dry. Abdomen is soft, non-tender, and non-distended. No hepatomegaly is noted. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs.

Assessment
1. History of hepatitis C, cured. The patient achieved SVR and currently has no active infection. There is no evidence of liver damage.

Plan
Continue current observation. No further medications are required at this time. The patient will return for a follow-up in one year.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: Hepatitis C cured with no current infection: personal history, Z86.19 (no HCC).

distractors.why: The hepatitis C was cured (sustained virologic response): code the history.
